messages:
claire: Quick RFC follow-up: propose incremental modular extraction of the runtime surface. Goal: peel capabilities (prefix-cache, session-affinity, prefetch) into tiny plugins behind a narrow contract so we can pay down routing and telemetry debt without a big-bang. Suggest a three-stage pattern: shim -> read-only -> full handoff.

raj: Agree on stages. Main risk: interface churn. Need versioned contract and trace-id propagation. Also short-lived creds for KMS access.

emily: For churn: consumer-driven contract tests in CI + compatibility harness that runs runtime against a plugin shim. Also propose chaos tests for plugin failures.

claire: Operational note: co-locate plugins with runtime (unix socket) for hotpaths to avoid extra hop. Fallback to remote service for multi-host or autoscaled nodes.

tom: Rollout plan: spike (shim + loopback, 1 week), read-only cohort (2 weeks), write-path canary (2 weeks). Include fast kill-switch and automatic fallbacks if p99 degrades.

ops-bot: infra-task created: provision-local-socket for spike (task 5321).

raj: Data ownership: move reads first for prefix-cache, move writes after stability. Add admin pin endpoint for strong-consistency on hot-keys.

emily: Observability: require trace_id header, token-cost markers, and per-plugin SLO dashboard. CI will include perf job to estimate unit-cost delta.

claire: Minimal contract sketch: POST /plugin/prefix_cache/lookup headers:{x-tenant,x-trace-id} body:{prefixes:["pre_a"],max_age_ms:100} response:{entries:[{prefix:"pre_a",present:true,source:"mem|db",ts:171234}],warnings:[]}

raj: Security: enumerate KMS ACL mapping and threat model. No plugin gets blanket tenant KMS. Use scoped, short-lived creds.

emily: I'll prototype shim and post initial perf tomorrow.

claire: Action items: claire -> follow-up RFC w/ contract + stages; raj -> ACL/KMS mapping; emily -> CI harness + perf job; tom -> ops playbook + rollback. Kick spike next Monday unless objections by COB Friday. Rolling forward.
